verdict.rationale: Publishing third-party authorization forms, delegate roles, and personal-signature rules is a fair question for a state business-filing authority, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes blocked by bot walls on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. None of it documents authorization forms, delegate roles, or which signatures must remain personal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
